blind.B1: Yes. GSE198652 is the RNA-seq deposit (S11.p1) of a late-life PoWeR (progressive weighted wheel running) vs sedentary study. All 34 samples are muscle (soleus/plantaris) from PoWeR or sedentary mice; every sample carries the exercise factor via characteristics group (PoWeR vs Sedentary). Not an in-vitro design.
blind.B2: Per muscle and age, PoWeR vs age-matched sedentary: old soleus and old plantaris Control n=5, PoWeR n=4 each (S2.8.p1); young (Englund cohort, 4-mo start) soleus and plantaris n=4/group, analyzed separately with the same pipeline (S2.8.p1, FIG7 A-H, S3.6.p1).
blind.B3: Soleus and plantaris come from the same animals (old IDs Con12_s / Con12_p), so tissue is a repeated measure, but the paper's comparisons are within one muscle, so no repeated sample enters a fit. Packet A lists no candidate pairing key. No pairing needed for per-muscle fits; it would be needed only for a joint tissue model.
blind.B4: Each muscle and age is analyzed separately: 'RNA-sequencing previously published by Englund et al. ... was analyzed separately using the same pipeline' (S2.8.p1); FIG7 panels are per muscle per age. The paper does not state in a sentence whether old soleus and plantaris were fitted jointly, but results are presented per muscle.
blind.B5: 'P values were adjusted using the Benjamini-Hochberg FDR step-up method' (S2.8.p1); 'FDR for sequencing experiments was set at < 0.10' (S2.10.p1); gProfiler ORA on genes with FDR < 0.10; Aldh1l1/Lrrn1 conserved genes at FDR < 0.05 (S3.7.p1). No fold-change cutoff. DESeq2 with minimum read cutoff of 50. Paper gives no DEG counts in text (Supplemental Tables 2A-D); it says very few genes were down in old plantaris (S3.6.p1).

checks.evidence: Run decision matches B1: all samples are PoWeR or sedentary muscle (packet A grp: Sed 18, PoW 16).

Strata SolOld 9 (5/4), PlaOld 9 (5/4), SolYoung 8 (4/4), PlaYoung 8 (4/4) equal the paper's n (S2.8.p1). Tissue taken from source_name_ch1/description suffix, not from the mislabelled 'Aged Soleus' titles of Con*_p/PoW*_p samples; recorded in paper_data_discrepancies. Control is the age- and muscle-matched sedentary group. No exclusions.

The four possible_reversed_contrast flags look like false positives (control Sed, treatment PoW is correct). Data confirm the sign: old soleus Aldh1l1 log2FC +0.62, Lrrn1 +0.78 (paper: higher with PoWeR, S3.7.p1); Agrn, Samd1, Zfp598 positive; oxidative genes Padi2/Ech1/Etfb negative (paper: oxidative metabolism lower, S3.6.p1).
Each fit uses one muscle only, so no animal appears twice within a fit; covariance record states this. No candidate pairing key in packet A.
Four separate ~grp fits, as in S2.8.p1 / FIG7; the joint ~tissue*age*grp alternative is rejected with a reason (young cohort is a different study).

Age is confounded with cohort and sequencing batch (young = Englund Pax7-DTA vehicle mice); recorded in design rejected alternatives and study caveats; young contrasts are labelled secondary and old-vs-young is not tested.

Partek estimated counts (74% integer) rounded for DESeq2, documented; matches paper's DESeq2 on counts. The max-count > 50 filter is applied inside each stratum while the paper says 'across all samples'; recorded as a deviation, effect small.
Applied padj < 0.10 (S2.10.p1, S2.8.p1), no fold-change rule, strict inequality; audit at 0.05 for the S3.7.p1 statement. ORA input uses the same rule as the paper's gProfiler query.
No paper DEG counts available (Supp Tables 2A-D); comparison is by named genes only and HANDBACK says so. Old plantaris 27 down is consistent with 'very few' down. No overclaim.
No stop or refusal in this case; all four contrasts executed.

summary: 四个 possible_reversed_contrast 标记是误报：对照为 Sed、处理为 PoW，方向正确，Aldh1l1、Lrrn1 等论文报告上调的基因在结果中均为正的 log2FC，氧化代谢基因为负。分组、样本数、逐肌肉逐年龄分别拟合、阈值 FDR<0.10 均与论文一致，同一动物的比目鱼肌与跖肌没有进入同一模型，因此无需配对。唯一的小偏差是表达量过滤在各层内进行，已记录。
